code:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: {{artifact_name}}
          path: {{path}}
          retention-days: 7

  # in another job
  consume:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with: { name: {{artifact_name}}, path: ./out }
summary_zh: GHA 上傳 / 下載 build artifact
